$comment: Read from the SIA chart set AD 2 LFKA (AIP France, chart dated 2025-09-04): the reporting points come from the coordinates table of the chart,
the notes from the English column of its text pages, both read by a script and checked (each point lies within 80 NM of the aerodrome).
Only what the chart prints is recorded; nothing is deduced. Services, frequencies, elevation, position, magnetic variation and runways
were first extracted automatically from the chart text. Drawings (circuit, routes, radials) are not read.
The charts themselves are (c) SIA and are not redistributed. Flight simulation only: never use for real navigation.
name: Albertville

source.extraction: chart text, table and English column read by script, checked

notes: AD reserved for airplanes and gliders whose pilots comply with following conditions: to be admitted as being able to use the AD by a pilot instructor (or holding and instructor rating),; to be mountain flight qualified.
AD usable by HEL and ULM.
If snow-covered ground, AD reserved for home-based ACFT only, under captain responsability.
Aerobatics activity LA ROCHETTE (NR 6812): see AIP ENR 5.5 Preferred RWY 23: valley breeze.
TKOF RWY 23: first turn at 1700 ft AMSL minimum.
TKOF RWY 05: as soon as possible, left turn and climb North sector.
Helicopter approach RWY 05 or 23: aim for runway center.
Respect for environment: (UTC WIN; SUM SKED: -1HR) Avoid overfly the sensitive area.
Home-based ACFT: Non home-based ACFT: ACFT: noise suppressor engine recommended.
Traffic patterns prohibited before 0800, between 1100 and 1300, WE and public HOL.
